HAR-168 server-vs-sandbox $ split: the $15.70/24 ($0.654) and $1.28/4 ($0.32) figures are measured-time UPPER bounds (mixed startup/idle windows), not settled invoices; no Modal billing rows for the 2026-10-06 campaign days were found in the local catalog (range ends 2026-10-01T16Z).

Dry-run ($0.28) and LoRA-server ($0.36 dry-run, $0.42 G4 vs catalog $0.4696) training-adjacent costs come from the har129-lora README's Modal billing-report reads; the local catalog has no 04h hourly rows for apps evallab-mimo-v26-9b-sft/-lora, so they cannot be re-verified by SQL.

HAR-116 wave-2 app ap-yXxcAQPhR4WRVkUd4thsUc carries hourly rows 01h ($0.64328196) + 02h ($1.06271086) that sum exactly to the daily/study figure $1.70599282; the study attributes the session-window cost. Whether the hourly tail is idle scaledown or reuse is not distinguished in the catalog.

G2 $0.153/run attributes only the 08h+09h rows to the 20 G2 trials and excludes the 07h $0.7622 chain-smoke row on the same app (per study README); full-app billing is $3.8236 ($0.189/run, as in g2-wave1/summary.json).

Per-call LLM wall timestamps do not exist anywhere: har116/g2 LLM time is sum(api_request_times_msec) per trial; har168 LLM time is sum(latency_ms) over reconciled proxy-live/calls.jsonl rows; lab-metadata.json provider_usage.calls[] has tokens/status but no timestamps, and ATIF trajectory steps have none either.
SGLang log timestamps are assumed UTC (no zone printed; container runs UTC per tunnel lines) - affects server batch/concurrency alignment, not trial stats.

KV pool inferences (kv_capacity_full_tokens ~745k, ceiling C~80, 17.5 GiB weights, 32 KiB/token) are planning inputs inferred from old telemetry (docs/execution-tiers.md), not measured startup-pool values.

Per-sandbox disk declared by tasks is unknown (task.toml has no disk key); 10 GiB is the Daytona dashboard per-sandbox cap (policy/daytona-limits.yaml), used as declared_sandbox.disk_gib only where the trial config records override_storage_mb=10240 (har116/g2).

HAR-168 ran at most 7 overlapping trials with no server-side telemetry, so 19-wide decode throughput, queueing and KV pressure for the current 64K/mimo.../qwen3_coder stack remain unmeasured (campaign_approval.py notes '19-wide decode unknown; HAR-168 records no per-trial wall times or server throughput' for the cost model).

No later-campaign native trials found locally: har164/runs/har157-rerun holds only specs/ledger (no trial result.json); har188 worktree holds only stage/tasks; HAR-189/193 have no local runs. Catalog billing range ends 2026-10-01T16Z, so nothing after G4 is invoice-backed locally.
